acceptanceCriteria: Dirty or uncertain archive state produces a cache with no fast-path-eligible sourceRevision.
A four-step dirty-modify, cache-generate, restore-clean, query sequence rebuilds from the restored archive and returns its record and sourceDigest.
Clean archive caches at the same HEAD retain the existing revision fast path.
Focused repository tests and the declared Runtime verification pass without changing unrelated behavior.
goal: Ensure a knowledge index generated from a dirty or uncertain archive never records a fast-path-eligible sourceRevision, and add a four-step dirty-to-clean regression proving records and sourceDigest follow the restored archive.
intent: Repair the knowledge cache sourceRevision trust boundary identified by acceptance review so dirty or uncertain archive state cannot qualify a cache for the clean-revision fast path.
outOfScope: Outcome wording and unrelated architecture tracks

scenarioCoverage.expected: A cache generated while a tracked archived contract is dirty cannot be reused after the contract is restored clean at the same HEAD; the next query rebuilds and returns the restored record and sourceDigest.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a four-step repository regression: commit baseline H, modify tracked archived contract, generate dirty cache, restore baseline bytes, generate again, and assert restored record plus digest.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A cache generated from a clean archive at HEAD retains sourceRevision and remains reusable without archive content validation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the existing clean-cache regression and assert sourceRevision remains bound to HEAD across consecutive queries.

scope: knowledge cache sourceRevision eligibility and dirty-to-clean regression
sources: Current acceptance review for main bf988ba2 identified the dirty-to-clean knowledge cache sourceRevision correctness gap.
